description: This file provides utility functions for Vulkan framework generation, including parsing Vulkan registry XML, managing extension and command data, and generating code snippets for Vulkan API initialization.

methods.name: indent
methods.description: Returns a string of 4-space indents multiplied by the input number.

methods.name: copyright_and_warning
methods.description: Generates a standard copyright and license header string for a given year.

methods.name: run_clang_format
methods.description: Runs clang-format on the specified file to enforce code style.

methods.name: is_extension_internal
methods.description: Checks if a Vulkan extension is internal to the loader and drivers.

methods.name: base_name
methods.description: Removes the 'vk' prefix from a Vulkan function name.

methods.name: base_ext_name
methods.description: Removes the 'VK_' prefix from a Vulkan extension name.

methods.name: version_code
methods.description: Extracts the version code from a Vulkan version string.

methods.name: version_2_api_version
methods.description: Converts a Vulkan version string to its corresponding API version string.

methods.name: is_function_supported
methods.description: Determines if a Vulkan function is supported (core or supportable extension).

methods.name: get_dispatch_table_type
methods.description: Returns the dispatch table type ('Global', 'Instance', 'Device') for a Vulkan function.

methods.name: is_globally_dispatched
methods.description: Checks if a Vulkan function is globally dispatched (not dispatched).

methods.name: is_instance_dispatched
methods.description: Checks if a Vulkan function can have instance-specific dispatch.

methods.name: is_device_dispatched
methods.description: Checks if a Vulkan function can have device-specific dispatch.

methods.name: is_extension_exported
methods.description: Checks if a Vulkan extension has functions exported by the loader.

methods.name: is_function_exported
methods.description: Checks if a Vulkan function is exported from the Vulkan library.

methods.name: is_instance_dispatch_table_entry
methods.description: Checks if a Vulkan function is exported and instance-dispatched.

methods.name: is_device_dispatch_table_entry
methods.description: Checks if a Vulkan function is exported and device-dispatched.

methods.name: init_proc
methods.description: Generates code to initialize a Vulkan function pointer.

methods.name: parse_vulkan_registry
methods.description: Parses the Vulkan XML registry to populate command, extension, and version data structures.
